title: River Walk traffic 2: the van, the taxi and the estate
note: The road's other three cars, made like the traffic family above (same method, one black ink, wheels drawn once and stamped twice, glass with one clean reflection, light from the upper left, no text or logos). Near lane, 55 px a metre: a white panel van (4.4 x 1.85 m), a yellow taxi with a plain lit roof box (the old one said TAXI), a silver 1990s estate with roof rails. Only their top half shows above the screen edge, so the taxi's roof is yellow (with a black roof it read as a dark car). SpriteCook 72 credits.
question: The van's old side said STOCKHOLM DELIVERY CO.; text is out, so its side is plain. Keep it plain, or give it a simple picture (a bun or a parcel, no letters)?
